'''January 2001 Columbus tournament (6 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Columbus, OH on 6 January 2001. It is known from Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1599">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-columbus-oh-1-6-01d1599/ columbus-oh-1-6-01], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-columbus-oh-1-6-01d1599/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Columbus, OH
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 14
